# Copilot Instructions

When editing imported draft model pages under `content/models/{slug}/{slug}.md`, fill missing information conservatively from the uploaded files, filenames, and existing repository conventions.

- Keep imported pages as `status: "draft"` until a human changes them.
- Fill `summary` with a short, concrete description.
- Add useful `tags` based on the filename, model type, and visible geometry.
- Improve the body text with overview, usage notes, scale/material notes, and print notes when they can be inferred.
- Do not invent license, authorship, commercial-use terms, redistribution terms, or safety claims.
- Preserve source filenames and existing front matter keys unless the user asks to rename or normalize them.
